protocol.title: Input Dose Differentiation by NF-kB
protocol.platform: Two-layer PDMS microfluidic chip (64 independent chambers, >500 cells/chamber)
cell_lines: 3T3 mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) expressing p65-DsRed and H2B-GFP
3T3 MEF A20 knockout (A20 KO) expressing p65-DsRed and H2B-GFP
protocol.objective: Microfluidic live-cell analysis of NF-kB (p65-DsRed) nuclear localization dynamics under dynamically varying cytokine concentrations (instant, linear, exponential, and random input profiles) to demonstrate dose differentiation behaviour and identify A20/IkBa negative feedback as the molecular mechanism

layers: Flow layer: AZ40XT positive photoresist (25 um, 3400 RPM) + SU-8 3025 negative photoresist (30 um, 3000 RPM) on 4-inch silicon wafer
Control layer: SU-8 3025 (25 um, 3500 RPM) on 4-inch silicon wafer
PDMS bulk layer (flow): RTV-615 66g 10:1 monomer:catalyst, ~2 cm thick, cured 80 C >5 h
PDMS thin layer (control): RTV-615 10g, spun at 2200 RPM ~50 um thick, cured 80 C >=1 h
Glass slide substrate: 75 x 25 x 1 mm, bonded by oxygen plasma + 80 C overnight

actuation.valve_control: Pneumatic solenoid valves + electronic controller boxes
actuation.software: Custom Matlab GUI with automated experiment scripting

device.coating: 1:3 fibronectin (1 mg/mL) in sterile PBS; overnight at room temperature

cell_culture_media.standard: DMEM (Gibco 11965092) + 10% fetal bovine calf serum (HyClone) + 1% GlutaMax (Gibco) + 1x penicillin-streptomycin (Gibco)
cell_culture_media.imaging: FluoroBrite DMEM (Gibco A1896702) + same supplements; used during experiments to reduce background fluorescence

Pam2CSK4.notes: Control ligand; NF-kB dose differentiation NOT observed for Pam; specific to TNFR/IL-1R pathway

reagents.surface_coating: Fibronectin 1 mg/mL in sterile PBS; 1:3 dilution; overnight room temperature
reagents.lysis_buffer: CellsDirect Kit lysis buffer (5 uL per sample); snap-frozen at -80 C

imaging.microscope: Nikon Ti2 enclosed in incubator box (life imaging services GmbH)
imaging.photobleaching: None observed over 150 image sets (~12 h)
imaging.flat_field_correction: Background fluorescence and dark frame images taken post-experiment

image_analysis.nuclear_segmentation: H2B-GFP images define nucleus position and boundary
image_analysis.nfkb_metric: Median nuclear p65-DsRed fluorescence per cell
image_analysis.background_subtraction: 20th percentile pixel brightness in sub-image around each cell
image_analysis.manual_inspection: ~100,000 cells inspected; ~30,000 selected (excluding death, division, focus artifacts)
readouts: area under curve (AUC) per oscillation period

mathematical_model.sensitivity_analysis: Each parameter varied 10-fold; chi-squared distance to differentiator behaviour used as sensitivity score
mathematical_model.key_finding: A20 and IkBa production/degradation parameters have highest sensitivity; nuclear transport rates have lowest sensitivity

a20_knockout.virus_production: HEK293T cells; supernatant collected at day 2, concentrated
a20_knockout.selection: Puromycin 2 ug/mL for 3-5 days until cell death subsided
a20_knockout.knockout_efficiency: ~90% protein reduction confirmed by Western blot
a20_knockout.background: p65-/- MEFs harboring p65-DsRed and H2B-GFP

targets.role: NF-kB negative feedback; expression mirrors NF-kB peak height
chemoattractant; expression increases regardless of input pattern
monocyte chemoattractant; mirrors TNF dose during ramping
inflammation regulator; requires large initial dose; minimal under exponential ramp
apoptosis facilitator; requires large initial dose; minimal under exponential ramp
anti-apoptotic; gradual increase under constant high TNF only

TNF_conditions.instant_increase: 10 ng/mL instantly; replenished every 60 min to prevent degradation
TNF_conditions.exponential_ramp: 2-fold increase every 60 min for 5 h to reach 10 ng/mL

cell_retrieval.method: Chip corner cut open; TrypsinEDTA ~1 min; PBS wash to open outlet; 2-3 uL droplet pipetted into 5 uL lysis buffer
cell_retrieval.storage: Snap-frozen at -80 C; CellsDirect lysis buffer

steps.name: Fibronectin surface coating
steps.duration_note: 12 h = 720 m = 43200 s; overnight at room temperature
steps.notes: 1:3 fibronectin (1 mg/mL) in sterile PBS; fills cell chambers; thorough coating required for cell adhesion

steps.name: Chamber flush and equilibration
steps.notes: Removes unbound fibronectin; equilibrates device to cell culture environment before loading

steps.name: Cell loading and settling
steps.notes: Chambers closed for at least 60 min after loading; cells must adhere firmly before feeding begins

steps.name: Baseline imaging (pre-stimulation)
steps.notes: Establishes pre-stimulus nuclear p65-DsRed localization in each cell (n > 200 per condition)

steps.name: Instant TNF stimulation
steps.duration_note: 300 min = 5 h constant high dose; replenished every 60 min
steps.expected_result: Strong initial NF-kB peak at ~25 min; subsequent oscillation amplitude decays exponentially (desensitisation to constant input)
steps.notes: Reference condition for comparison with linear and exponential ramps

steps.name: Instant IL-1beta stimulation
steps.expected_result: Parallel dynamics to TNF instant increase; strong initial peak followed by oscillation decay
steps.notes: IL-1beta arm of instant stimulation control

steps.name: Linear TNF ramp (5 steps)
steps.expected_result: Sustained NF-kB oscillations with constant AUC at each step; confirms dose differentiation (NF-kB ~ log(delta_cytokine))

steps.name: Linear IL-1beta ramp (5 steps)
steps.expected_result: Constant AUC across all steps; differentiator behaviour confirmed for IL-1beta
steps.notes: Parallel to linear TNF ramp; both cytokines show identical differentiator behaviour (Fig. 2A)

steps.name: Exponential TNF ramp (5 steps)
steps.expected_result: Continuously increasing NF-kB peak AUC; log-linear fit: adjusted R-squared ~0.963 (Fig. 2B)
steps.qc_note: nfkbExpTNF_s5 (final step) used as QC gate input for nfkbSignal branch

steps.name: Exponential IL-1beta ramp (5 steps)
steps.expected_result: AUC increases linearly with log(delta_IL1beta); same differentiator relationship as TNF (Fig. 2B)

steps.name: Random-order TNF fluctuation (4 steps)
steps.expected_result: AUC vs delta_TNF: linear for positive changes (correlation ~0.91); sharp drop for any decrease; confirms rectified differentiator behaviour
steps.notes: Tests robustness of differentiator behaviour under arbitrary input complexity (Fig. 2C)

steps.name: Pam2CSK4 exponential ramp control (5 steps)

ramp_profile.step_duration_note: 60 min doubling time (30 min also tested)

steps.expected_result: Majority of cells show 1-2 sharp peaks only; AUC slopes span negative to positive across single-cell clusters; dose differentiation NOT observed for TLR2 ligand
steps.notes: Single-cell clustering by Matlab linkage (ward/correlation): 4 groups; all positive TNF slopes vs mixed Pam slopes. Confirms differentiator specificity to TNFR/IL-1R pathway (Fig. 3)

steps.name: NF-kB response QC gate
steps.notes: QC anchored on exponential TNF ramp final step; valid response requires sustained oscillatory NF-kB with positive AUC slope

steps.name: Cell viability assay (FDA/PI)
steps.stain_incubation_note: 10 min in dark at room temperature
steps.notes: FDA (ex 490/em 526 nm) labels live cells; PI (ex 488/em 617 nm) labels dead cells; >80% viability required for valid experiment

steps.name: Cell retrieval, lysis, and RT-qPCR
steps.detection_duration_note: 120 min = RT + pre-amplification + qPCR on CFX384
steps.storage_note: Snap-frozen at -80 C between retrieval and qPCR; not encoded in BioScript (compiler drops negative temperature sign)

key_results.linear_ramp_result: Constant NF-kB AUC at each step
key_results.random_input_result: Correlation coefficient ~0.91 for positive delta_TNF; sharp drop for any decrease
key_results.pam_result: No dose differentiation observed (TLR2 pathway); AUC slopes mixed positive/negative across clusters

a20_ko_result.exponential_ramp: Saturation at much lower TNF dose; differentiator response abolished
a20_ko_result.constant_dose: NF-kB still decreasing at 120 min vs 60 min for WT; oscillation frequency halved
a20_ko_result.random_input: Correlation reduced to ~0.76; NF-kB remains nuclear even after dose decrease

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: fibronectin coating, flush, cell loading, baseline imaging, all stimulation arms (instant TNF/IL1B, linear TNF/IL1B x5, exponential TNF/IL1B x5, random TNF x4, Pam x5), nfkbSignal QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose(nfkbSignal); FDA/PI viability stain; viabilitySignal detect
